title: PRISM: A neural network component for better robotic motor control
description: Learning physical interactions helps robots move more reliably, handle objects and adapt to unfamiliar conditions—without larger networks or extra sensors.

image.alt: Left: A humanoid robot walks forward. An arrow labeled “state history” points to the robot’s hip and knee joint. A flow chart indicates the hip and knee joint information is multiplied to yield interactions that form robot policy.
